identificationModule.officialTitle: Understanding Long-Term Outcomes of Oncoplastic Breast Surgery

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a retrospective and prospective chart review of surgical outcomes and collecting patient satisfaction outcomes using validated surveys for oncoplastic breast surgery and Goldilocks mastectomy.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a retrospective and prospective chart review from 2015-2045 of oncoplastic breast surgery and mastectomy patients at Tufts Medicine.

interventions.name: Oncoplastic Breast Surgery
interventions.description: Breast conservation surgery incorporating an oncologic partial mastectomy with ipsilateral defect repair using volume displacement or volume replacement techniques with contralateral symmetry surgery as appropriate

primaryOutcomes.description: The TNM system of cancer classification determines the stage of cancer based on type of cancer, size of cancer, lymph node status, presence of metastasis
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to up to 1 month after surgery.

primaryOutcomes.description: Measured using validated surveys pre-operative and post-operative (2 week, 6 month, 1 year).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to 1 year after surgery.

primaryOutcomes.description: Recurrence of cancer following surgery and adjuvant therapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to 20 years after surgery

secondaryOutcomes.description: The investigators will measure rates of positive margins after cancer resection that requires additional resection.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to 1 year after initial surgery

secondaryOutcomes.description: Complications from surgery (infection, wound dehiscence, seroma, hematoma, etc.) will be measured and aggregated into a overall rate of major complications (requires intervention) and minor complications as percentages.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of surgery up to 5 years after surgery

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Biological females \>= 18 years old requiring oncologic breast surgery with and without reconstruction at Tufts Medicine.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Biological females \< 18 years old
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Patients of Tufts Medicine hospitals requiring oncologic breast surgery with and without reconstruction.
